description: SHA-256 consistent-hash rollout-bucketing determinism vectors. FORWARD PROVISION (bd:envpit-0t2z.3 Slice 0, per SPEC-envpit-0t2z-3-1a-architecture.md §6) — no shipped SDK language consumes this yet; Feature Flags SDK support ships under bd:envpit-0t2z.6. Reserved here now so every language's future implementation proves identical bucketing against the exact same ground truth from day one, instead of being ported from prose.

algorithm.spec: bucket = (first 4 bytes of SHA-256(UTF-8(salt + ":" + key)), read as a BIG-ENDIAN UNSIGNED 32-bit integer) mod 10000
notes: No normalization of `key` — no trim, no case-fold, no Unicode normalization; raw UTF-8 bytes as given.
The 32-bit read MUST be unsigned (the JVM signed-int trap called out by AC-SEC-F11b) — Java ports must use `& 0xFFFFFFFFL` or an equivalent unsigned read, not a plain `int`.
bucket is always an integer in [0, 9999] — never a float.

sourceOfTruth: envpit (main repo) libs/shared/src/flag-evaluation-vectors.ts — FLAG_BUCKET_GOLDEN_VECTORS + GOLDEN_VECTOR_SALT, doc-comment-pinned independent of computeFlagBucket's own implementation (libs/shared/src/flag-evaluator.ts) so a bug in that function cannot make its own conformance test tautologically pass.
